description: The main window, and in it only the bundled chooser page (the app's own origin), may use IPC. The chooser calls nothing but the app's own commands (get_state, connect_local, connect_remote, pick_library, set_library, open_library, check_update, install_update, cancel_update, set_theme, set_update_check, forget_choice, open_logs, set_share, reset_share_code), which Tauri allows for the app's own origin because there is no app ACL manifest and no capability has a `remote` key: so this grants no core or plugin permission at all. Pages served over http(s) — the local server's UI and other computers' servers — get no IPC, and in-app windows for links (labels page-N) match no capability. The updater plugin is driven from Rust only: its commands are denied to every page, the chooser included.
